title: A Forgotten Dish Of Mould Changed Medicine 🧫
caption:
A messy lab and a forgotten dish changed medicine 🧫
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. In 1928 Alexander Fleming returned from holiday to find mould growing on one of his bacteria dishes, with the bacteria around it dead. The mould was Penicillium, and penicillin became the first widely used antibiotic.
Would you have thrown it away? 👇
first_comment: Messy lab, world changed. Would YOU have thrown that dish away? 🧫👇
